aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Intra-State vs Inter-State Returns
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(source_state) = UPPER(destination_state) THEN 'Intra-State'
    ELSE 'Inter-State'
  END AS gst_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(tax_igst_amount) AS igst,
  SUM(tax_cgst_amount) AS cgst,
  SUM(tax_sgst_amount) AS sgst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1;
